title: What are AI agents in customer support? A 2026 B2B guide | Pylon
summary: An AI agent in customer support reads a customer's question, gathers the context it needs, and then answers or takes an action.
body_markdown:
An AI agent in customer support reads a customer's question, gathers the context it needs, and then answers or takes an action. When judgment is needed, it hands off to a person. In B2B support, agents work best when they can see the account: the customer's plan, SLA, past issues, and open engineering bugs.


## How do AI agents compare with chatbots and AI assistants?


Scripted chatbot AI assistant for agents AI agent


Who it helps Customers Your support team Customers, your team, and internal teams


How it works Fixed flows or FAQ lookup Suggests drafts and summaries Reads context, uses tools, and takes action


Takes action Rarely A person acts Yes, within the permissions you set


Hands off to people Fixed rules Not applicable Based on your guidance and escalation rules

## What can an agent do on a support issue?


Each request goes through five steps:


1. Agents rebuild the current state of the issue.
2. They load context from your support history, the account, and product knowledge.
3. They act, observe the result, and adapt.
4. Guardrails check the work and require approval where you set it.
5. The run is recorded so the next one improves.


Typical actions:


- Search the knowledge base
- Read CRM data
- Draft or send a reply
- Set fields
- Link a Jira or Linear issue
- Call your own API through custom actions


The Pylon MCP server exposes tools such as search_issues, update_issue, send_issue_reply, and link_product_issue, so outside agents can work with the same data.

## How do you deploy an agent safely?


Start with one channel and one well-documented issue type, then expand. The full rollout plan is in[AI-powered customer support in 2026](https://www.usepylon.com/blog/ai-powered-customer-support-guide) .


## How are AI agents priced?


Common models are per resolution, per conversation, per seat, and credits. In Pylon, agents run on agentic credits shared across the team, on top of seats. Professional is $89 per seat per month and Advanced is $139 per seat per month, on an annual contract. Enterprise is a custom quote. Assist Agent, Support Agent, Slack Agent, and Automations use credits on every plan. The minimum credit commitment is 5,000 credits, and you can buy more in the product. There are no per-issue fees.


## FAQ


### What is an AI agent in customer support?


Software that reads a request, gathers context, and answers or acts. It escalates to a person when needed.


### Can agents take action in other tools?


Yes, within the permissions you set. Pylon agents use MCP connectors and custom API actions, which are available on every plan.


### Can I bring my own agent?


Yes. Pylon supports bring your own agent, and the MCP server is on every plan.


### Do agents work in other languages?


Pylon offers issue auto-translation on Advanced and above. Knowledge base auto-translation covers 2 languages on Professional and is full on Advanced and above.
